providers.description: Indexed, source-hash-fenced implementation evidence for Vrooli symbols, functions, packages, and files. Use this leaf to locate concrete application code, policy logic, persistence, and source ownership. It does not claim authoritative call-graph evidence or proto-contract coverage; use the contracts leaf or the typed Describe APIs for those questions.
providers.config_pinned_reason: Code Facts hybrid construction and generation policy are governed by its typed index controls; Search Hub may evaluate but not rewrite them.

tests.name: Natural-language code question retrieval
